The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in campaign margins and total annual decision metrics.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a value mismatch in campaign data: close(468.0, 7956.0) returned False. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because total_annual_margin_6_day_usd was -45894.84 instead of the expected -83406.84. These errors occurred in /tests/test_outputs.py during the pytest suite execution, indicating the cost-benefit calculation logic is producing incorrect financial outputs.
